contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [---]S PF AVG ; R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian, Securitas Rei Publicae issue of 364-378, Siscia mint, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust diademed right. Obverse inscription: [---]S PF AVG. Reverse description: Figure advancing left; it appears to wear a tunic not robes. Reverse inscription: SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. In exergue: [?]SISC. Diameter: 18.2mm, Weight: 1.78gms, die axis: 6
